notes.title: Update to version 1.0.0.2
notes.content:
[h2]This update is mainly focused on adding localization for French and German languages.[/h2]

On the main menu of the game you'll now be able to find a flag icon. Clicking the icon (X on controller) will allow you to change the language to either French or German.

Additional changes:

[list]
[*] Bonus levels are now updated to be a bit more visually diverse.
[*] When zoomed in (scroll wheel or trigger buttons on controller), the camera will now smoothly transition between floors when riding the elevator.
[/list]

notes.title: Update v1.0.0.1 - Small quality of life change
notes.content:
[h1]Update version 1.0.0.1[/h1]

[b]Quality of life change:[/b]

While carying a Broom, Mop, Vacuum or Power Scrubber, players can drop these items throughout the hotel as long as they don't overlap with other interactable items. 

A UI tooltip now displays whenever the player can drop these items.

When playing via Keyboard and Mouse, drop these items by pressing the "F" key.
When playing via XBox controller, drop these items by pressing the "X" button.
